load_audit.method: Exclude all-zero NVML process-utilization entries. Exclude a stale compute entry only when the same PID was observed as an owned worker <=2 seconds earlier, aggregate used memory is below the stale allocation, and aggregate utilization is 0.
load_audit.scope: Sampled GPU process presence only. CPU, storage, and the server remain shared.

plan.acceptance: both full output audits and exact logical equality; score designated frame 1 only
plan.handedness: FreiHAND right-hand prior; no automatic side claim
plan.pose_throughput_numerator: 20 mm wrist-relative MPJPE and correct side at scored frame
plan.scope: static hand-pose ground truth through 3-frame video interfaces; no temporal quality claim
plan.source: Official FreiHAND evaluation v2, pre-existing seed 20261102 replication set

timing_controls.GPU: Single physical V100, selected by UUID.
timing_controls.during_trial: Sample outside compute PIDs and their available NVML process counters every 0.5 seconds. Separate paired results by observed GPU sharing.
timing_controls.host: Same server, alternating order. Host CPU, I/O, and the NVML sampling intervals are shared.
timing_controls.preflight: Require 10 GiB free throughout a 10-second preflight before each arm.
timing_controls.selection: Prefer cards without CUDA work, then lower p90 and median NVML utilization among those with >=10 GiB free throughout the sample.
